name: Rummu quarry
description: A Soviet limestone quarry worked by prison labour until 1991, then abandoned and left to flood. The water is very clear, the spoil heap next to it is white, and parts of the prison buildings are still under the surface.
getting: 45 minutes west of Tallinn by car. It's a paid, managed site now with proper access — the free-for-all trespassing era ended and the fences are real.
